title: BXDC IPO lockup ends — Blackstone Digital Infrastructure Trust, 180 days after its 2026-05-13 prospectus
source: SEC: 424B4 https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/2100161/000119312526225090/d52761d424b4.htm, fetched 2026-10-20 (scripts/research/lockup-discovery.mjs). Prospectus dated 2026-05-13 (read from its cover); 180 days after it is 2026-11-09. Lock-up clause: "However, shares issued to our directors and officers are subject to lock-up arrangements, as described herein, and generally may not be sold for 180 days from the date of this prospectus, except subject to certain exceptions or with the prior written consent of the representatives of the underwriters."
notes: $1.8B offering. One 180-day period, no early-release trigger (424B4 re-read 2026-10-20); first free session is Tue 2026-11-10. Only the Blackstone Investor (9.1M shares) and directed-share buyers (1.8M) are locked, about 11% of ~100.6M shares, both at a $20.00 cost; IPO investors have traded freely since 2026-05-14. The pullback the lockup-expiry playbook studies (#5912) is the supply that unlocks then.
